transcript.text: gas hob keeps clickin on its own since i cleand it, stops then starts agen. drivin me mad. pls help

First switch it off at the wall or cooker switch and let it cool completely. That clicking is the spark igniter firing repeatedly. Since it started after cleaning, the most likely cause is that water or soap has reached the ignition switch under the knob, or moisture/debris is on the electrode itself. A less common but simple cause is a burner cap sitting slightly askew. Please remove the burner caps and bases for the affected burners to ensure they are completely dry and clean, wipe the white ignition tip gently with a dry cloth, and re-seat them firmly. If you have gas knobs that click without any burner present, please also check if the knob itself feels damp or sticky inside.

ok did that, took the caps off and dried them. one was a bit wonky so i put it back properly, and wiped some grease off the tip. no gas smell btw. i did slosh loads of water about tho. still clickin on and off

Since drying the caps didn't stop the clicking, the moisture has likely seeped into the ignition switch under the knob or onto the spark module itself. If it's damp, leave the area open to air (you can use a hairdryer on cool/low heat from a distance) for several hours or overnight; if it's dry but still clicking, the module itself may have failed and needs an engineer.

candidates: Moisture or debris on the ignition switch/electrode from cleaning (high)
Burner cap not seated correctly after cleaning (medium)
